# RYXO

> RYXO is a caffeine-free energy drink brand from Switzerland. Energy taste, 0 mg caffeine. Pre-launch: the first drop (001) is planned for April 2027 and launch dates may change. (Deutsch: RYXO ist eine koffeinfreie Energy-Drink-Marke aus der Schweiz.)

## Key facts

- Brand name: RYXO (also written RYXO Energy)
- Category: caffeine-free energy drink / koffeinfreier Energy Drink
- Origin: Switzerland ("Born in Switzerland. Built for everywhere.")
- Status: pre-launch, not on sale yet
- Planned first drop: April 2027
- Current lineup: Tropical, Berry, Original, White Citrus, Watermelon (500 ml cans)
- Languages: English and German
- Website: https://ryxoenergy.com/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ryxoenergy
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@ryxoenergy
- Contact: contact@businessjourney26.com
